AC Remodeling — Design-Build Kitchen, Bathroom & Basement Remodeling in MD & DC
Built around the way you live.

For over 15 years, AC Remodeling has helped homeowners across Montgomery County and Northwest DC transform the way they live. We bring together thoughtful design, master-led craftsmanship and a genuinely collaborative process to create spaces that are as functional as they are beautiful.

REQUEST MY CONSULTATION
VIEW PORTFOLIO
“

“A.C. Remodeling did a great job remodeling my kitchen and bathrooms. It was a pleasure working with Alex, Carolina and the whole crew.”

Barbara Kriss

FULL-SERVICE REMODELING

From concept to completion.

We manage every detail of your project with precision, transparency and a commitment to quality that lasts.

Kitchen Remodeling

Custom cabinetry, stone surfaces and lighting designed around how you actually cook and gather.

Bathroom Remodeling

Spa-quality primary baths with warm stone, frameless glass and lighting that flatters.

Basement Remodeling

Basements that feel like the rest of the house — warm, dry, bright and fully permitted.

Design Build

One accountable team, from first sketch through completion.

OUR WORK

Step inside a finished project.

Choose a collection to see the full photo set — every detail, from demolition-day decisions to the final install.

Kitchen in Bethesda

BETHESDA, MD

Designed for both functional cooking and entertaining, this warm two-tone kitchen pairs cream perimeter cabinets with a rich stained wood center island. Quartz Sono Soleil counters and warm brass fixtures create a seamless blend of timeless character and modern luxury.

VIEW PROJECT
White Kitchen in Bethesda

BETHESDA, MD

This full kitchen remodel features sleek white cabinetry paired with luxurious Quartzite Matarazzo countertops and a seamless waterfall edge. Custom storage solutions and elegant brass accents complete this dream kitchen for our clients.

VIEW PROJECT
Hall Bath & Master Bathroom in Gaithersburg

GAITHERSBURG, MD

Master Suite: A spa-inspired oasis centered around a freestanding tub, rich navy dual-sink cabinetry, backlit mirrors, and an expansive quartzite-look porcelain walk-in shower. Hall Bath: Features coastal-inspired tilework, a teal glass mosaic accent, and high-contrast matte black fixtures. Together, these renovations effortlessly blend high design with everyday practicality.

VIEW PROJECT
Primary Bath in Rockville

ROCKVILLE, MD

Blending soothing tones with high-end finishes, this primary bath renovation pairs an Ocean White Matte Beyond Calacatta backsplash with bright white shaker cabinetry for an airy, spa-like feel. The modern walk-in shower is enclosed in frameless glass and features textured wave wall tile, brushed nickel fixtures, and safety grab bars for the ultimate daily getaway.

OUR CORE TEAM

Founder-led, on site every day.

AC Remodeling is a family-owned design-build firm founded in Gaithersburg in 2009. No middle management — the owners run your project.

Alex Reyes

PRESIDENT & CEO

Licensed contractor and unabashed perfectionist. Alex is on site daily, holding construction quality, materials and detailing to his own standard.

“I pride myself on high-quality work, never cutting corners, and paying the utmost attention to details.”

Carolina Reyes

MANAGING DIRECTOR

Carolina leads design direction, joins every client meeting and translates your wish list into a plan our build team can deliver on budget.

“We are here for you. Our top priority is making your life easier through the whole project.”

Melissa Rojas

DESIGN ASSISTANT

Melissa guides you through selections and showroom visits, balancing beauty and function down to the last tile, fixture and finish.

“I am my happiest when creating a space that brings you joy.”

FROM VISION TO REALITY

Every great renovation starts with a great plan.

Our design-build team makes remodeling simple, transparent and enjoyable from start to finish. From your initial consultation to custom 3D designs, material selections, construction and the final walkthrough, we handle every detail under one roof — so you always know what to expect.

Design, engineering, permitting and construction live with one accountable team — 15+ years of remodeling homes across Montgomery County and Northwest DC, with local codes and permits handled for you.

One dedicated project manager, weekly written progress reports, a shared schedule and same-day responses — plus a multi-year workmanship warranty from a company that answers the phone.

KITCHEN REMODELING

Kitchens designed as architecture.

Designed, priced and built by one team.

Request My Consultation

One team from design to completion.

Most kitchen projects fail in the gap between the designer and the builder. We remove the gap: the same firm draws your kitchen, pulls the permits and builds it with our own long-tenured crew.

You review a 3D rendering and a detailed proposal before demolition. From there you have one project manager, a written weekly update and a schedule you can plan your life around.

WHAT'S INCLUDED

Where the craftsmanship shows.
Cabinetry

Custom and semi-custom cabinetry, primarily in painted maple, with a range of stains, woods and finishes to match your style. Full-overlay, soft-close construction throughout.

Stone & surfaces

Quartzite and engineered quartz, precisely measured and seamed where you won't see it. Chosen for durability as much as beauty.

Lighting

Layered ceiling, task and accent lighting on dimmers, thoughtfully planned for how the room is actually used.

Storage plan

Every drawer assigned before we order: spice pull-outs, appliance garages, tray dividers, hidden waste and pantry systems.

Structure & systems

Wall removals, beams, HVAC re-routing, panel upgrades and new plumbing handled under one permit and one contract.

Appliance integration

Panel-ready refrigeration and ventilation sized to your range, with rough-ins coordinated closely with the appliance dealer.

01
Design & selections

Measurements, 3D plans, material selections and a detailed proposal.

3–5 weeks

Permitting & ordering

County permits filed, cabinetry and long-lead items released.

3–6 weeks
03
Construction

Demolition, rough-ins, inspections, cabinetry, stone, tile and finishes.

6–9 weeks

Final detailing, deep clean, care guide and warranty handoff.

1 week

CLIENT REVIEWS

Our clients say it best — beautiful homes, built to perfection.

REMODELING IN GAITHERSBURG

What a Gaithersburg project looks like.

Because our office and shop are here, Gaithersburg projects get the shortest lines of communication we can offer. Deliveries stage locally, the project manager stops by between other visits, and a question raised in the morning usually has an answer the same day rather than the same week.

Most of the work we do here falls into three groups: kitchens that need a full layout change rather than new doors on old boxes, primary and hall bathrooms taken back to the studs, and unfinished basements built out with a family room, a bar and a full bath. Townhome kitchens in Kentlands and Lakelands often involve relocating plumbing and rebuilding a peninsula into a working island, while the larger detached homes closer to Quince Orchard tend toward opening the kitchen to the family room.

Every project runs on drawings, a detailed scope and one accountable team from first sketch through final detailing. Permits are filed with Montgomery County DPS and, where the property sits inside city limits, with the City of Gaithersburg.

GAITHERSBURG SCOPE

Kitchens, baths and basements in Gaithersburg.
Kitchen Remodeling in Gaithersburg

Kentlands and Lakelands townhome kitchens usually start as a galley with a peninsula that blocks the only path through the room. The fix is a full layout change: relocate the sink and gas line, rebuild the peninsula as a working island with seating on one side, and take cabinetry to the ceiling to recover the storage lost to appliance panels.

See how our kitchen remodeling process works
Bathroom Remodeling in Gaithersburg

Hall baths in Washingtonian Woods and Quince Orchard tend to be tub-only with a single small window. We take them to the studs, waterproof the full wet wall to manufacturer spec, and rebuild with slab-look porcelain, a recessed niche and layered lighting so a five-by-eight room stops feeling like a closet.

See how our bathroom remodeling process works
Basement Remodeling in Gaithersburg

Because our shop is minutes away, basement builds here stage materials locally and keep dust and traffic out of the rest of the house. A typical scope is a family room, a bar wall, a guest bedroom with proper egress and a full bath, permitted through Montgomery County DPS.

Home Remodeling in
Rockville, MD

Rockville's housing stock is exceptionally varied, from post-war ramblers in Twinbrook to larger colonials in Potomac Woods. Most of our Rockville work involves opening compartmentalized floor plans, modernizing systems and finishing basements.

CLIENT REVIEWS

Our clients say it best — beautiful homes, built to perfection.

REMODELING IN ROCKVILLE

What a Rockville project looks like.

The recurring problem in Rockville is a floor plan drawn for the way families lived decades ago: a kitchen closed off behind a wall, a formal dining room nobody eats in, and a basement that stores boxes. Our design work usually starts by testing whether one or two walls can come out, and what that means structurally, before any finish is chosen.

Ramblers and split-levels also tend to bring original plumbing, undersized electrical service and duct runs in awkward places. Those are addressed during design rather than discovered mid-construction, and the beam, columns and footings needed to carry a removed wall are drawn by a structural engineer and written into the scope.

Alongside kitchens, we build a steady stream of Rockville primary baths and finished basements with bedrooms and full baths that meet egress and code requirements. Everything is permitted through Montgomery County DPS and inspected as the work progresses.

ROCKVILLE SCOPE

Kitchens, baths and basements in Rockville.
Kitchen Remodeling in Rockville

Twinbrook ramblers and Potomac Woods colonials share the same problem: a kitchen walled off from where the family actually sits. We test which walls can come out during design, have the beam, columns and footings drawn by a structural engineer, and lay the room out around one island rather than a peninsula.

See how our kitchen remodeling process works
Bathroom Remodeling in Rockville

Primary baths in mid-century Rockville homes are often two small original rooms and a hallway closet. Combining them gives room for a double vanity, a low-threshold shower with frameless glass and a private water closet, with old supply lines and undersized circuits replaced while the walls are open.

See how our bathroom remodeling process works
Basement Remodeling in Rockville

King Farm and Fallsmead basements are frequently built out as a legal bedroom with egress, a full bath and a family room. Duct runs get rerouted where they cost ceiling height, and plumbing inspection is closed out before the building inspection, which is how Montgomery County sequences it.

REMODELING IN BETHESDA

What a Bethesda project looks like.

Older Bethesda homes rarely give you flat walls, square corners or plumb openings. Fitting custom cabinetry into that reality is a measuring and scribing exercise, not a catalogue order, which is why our cabinetry is custom or semi-custom with full-overlay, soft-close construction and finishes chosen to sit beside existing woodwork rather than fight it.

Kitchens here often involve reworking a rear addition, relocating a powder room or rebuilding a butler's pantry, and primary suites frequently mean borrowing space from a hallway or an under-used bedroom. Both depend on drawings and a 3D design that let you see the room before demolition starts.

Bethesda also carries real permitting complexity. Projects go through Montgomery County DPS, and in the designated historic districts we handle historic area work permits and coordinate with the Historic Preservation Commission as part of the schedule rather than as an afterthought.
